broader_clean_panel_audit.sampling_guardrail: The panel is month-stratified deterministic and deliberately retains two largest clusters per month; this is an audit-panel rate, not an ecosystem prevalence estimate.
broader_clean_panel_audit.timing_guardrail: Weekly event date is a checkpoint rather than exact BGP transition time; exact multi-RRC replay supplies the precise-date mechanism confirmation.

novelty_guardrails.do_not_claim: Do not claim discovery of the possibility that an old covering ROA can make a new origin Invalid during transfer/migration. RFC 6907 already describes this operational risk and recommends issuing the new ROA before BGP advertisement.
novelty_guardrails.closest_propagation_neighbor: RPKI Time-of-Flight (PAM 2023) measures controlled ROA propagation and data-plane reaction, generally minutes to about an hour; our months-long old-origin authorization observations are operator authorization lifecycle, not propagation latency.
novelty_guardrails.defensible_contribution: Systematically enumerate natural persistent BGP origin handoffs over one year; measure asymmetric old/new authorization lifecycles; align a multi-RRC exact transition subset; demonstrate naturally occurring strict-ROV policy inversions; independently reproduce headline inversions from RIPE NCC daily validated VRP archives; and show why a fixed symmetric delay is the wrong handoff abstraction.

recommended_paper_thesis: Persistent BGP origin handoffs are not atomic authorization transitions. In natural handoffs, routing can enter a policy-inverted state where the new origin is RPKI Invalid while the displaced origin remains Valid, while old-origin authorization can persist long after routing moves. This motivates a state-gated make-before-break procedure rather than a fixed symmetric delay.

operational_rule.activation: Create the new-origin authorization before the BGP switch and verify that it is visible to RPKI validation before activating the new origin.
operational_rule.retirement: Do not revoke the old authorization after a fixed timer alone; combine multi-collector routing quiescence, fallback/intent checks, and an independently measured RPKI propagation budget.
